question: Identify the animal that does NOT have bilateral symmetry.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cnidarian.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **Cnidarians are the only animal group that lacks bilateral symmetry.**
 
• They are radially symmetrical, meaning their body parts are arranged around a central axis like the spokes of a wheel.
 
• The absence of bilateral symmetry in cnidarians is due to their simple body plan
